youtube.title: Fixing the Hebrew on an emblem: every letter typed, not guessed
youtube.description:
Changing the Hebrew text on an emblem means every letter has to be exact.
The text is typed once and drawn in code, then redrawn over three drafts to match the original's slanted block letters.
The emblem was drawn in code with Claude; this video was made with funkbox.
Free, open source, runs locally: https://github.com/IsraelWebDev/funkbox
Made with funkbox.
